newsitem.title: UK: LME metals meander in ranges, copper softens.
newsitem.headline: LME metals meander in ranges, copper softens.

text.p: COPPER - Drifts lower within range to $6 softer $2,354. Cash/threes backwardation contracts from wider morning levels to little changed $60/$65.
ALUMINIUM - Just steadier at $1,634. Off highs after failing to break above $1,640 resistance.
ZINC - Little changed at $1,278. NICKEL - Slightly firmer at $7,500. TIN - Softer. LEAD - Easier. ALLOY - Quiet.
